• Attached or Detached Garages

• Carports

• Electric
• Fences
• Downspouts
• Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
• New residential construction
• Roof Replacement and Repair
• Portable Storage Units / Construction Dumpsters

• Sheds or other Accessory Structures
• Window or Door Replacements (If structural altercations are made)

ELECTRIC PERMITS 4.
In early 2020, the City of Sharonville partnered with National
Inspection Corporation (NIC) to perform electric plan review,
approvals and inspections in an effort to improve the convenience to
residents and businesses.
All electric permits and plans can be emailed or dropped off at the
City of Sharonville Community Development Department Office to
start the electric permit approval process.
Once the permit is approved, you will be contacted for payment of
the electric permit fee, and the permit will be issued.
All electrical inspections are handled directly by NIC.
If you have any general
administrative questions
about electric permitting,
please contact us at
513-563-0033
For specific electric
permitting questions
please call NIC at
888-433-4642

6
INSPECTIONS 5.
List of Typical Residential Building Inspections
• Soil / Footing Inspection
• Site / Erosion Controls
• Foundation / Steel Reinforcement
• Under Slab / Vapor Barrier
• Framing / Shear Wall
• Above Ceiling HVAC / Duct Seal
• HVAC
• Insulation
• Gas and Pressure piping test
• Temporary structures (tents, special events)
• Temporary Certificate of Occupancy
• Site inspection, elevation certificate if in
Flood zone
• Special Inspection final report (if required)
• Final inspection, Certificate of Complaince/
or Certification of Occupancy

CURRENT ZONING MAP 6.
1. Go onto the City of Sharonville website sharonville.org

4. Click on Zoning Map on the left side of the screen
5. To find the legend , in the top left, click on the two arrows ( >> )
